blast_radius: Read/upsert into the ER2 ticket store; no outbound mail.

throughput.derivation: Read-only database query inside the service's own container over one SSH session. sum(upserted) grouped by day(started_at) over a trailing window; 24h = sum(upserted) where started_at >= now()-24h.
notes: A high number of sync runs complete in 24h with no error column set (illustrative: roughly 1,900 runs).

Separately, a small share of upstream provider calls fail with auth or rate-limit errors in 24h; that failure mode does not surface in this loop's own error column and is tracked on loop-er2-llm-burn.
throughput.signal_path: postgres://example-service-db/example_service (container-local; credentials in EXAMPLE_SERVICE_* env, never read by capmap)#sync_runs

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.
verification.source: postgres://example-service-db/example_service (container-local; credentials in EXAMPLE_SERVICE_* env, never read by capmap)#sync_runs

what_it_does: Support-ticket ingest loop; volume is tickets upserted per sync run.
why_it_matters: This is the front of the support pipeline; a stall here means nothing downstream (classification, deflection, replies) ever sees new tickets.
